headline: IRON RING: the dash and supers reconnect
lede: Multi-hit specials landed in IRON RING — HYDE's dash is now a 2-4 hit rushing shoulder-charge and the melee supers chain across the roster, resumed from a dead session's pushed branch and shipped the same day.

notes.text: #1699 shipped (PR #1706, squash 1ab2ffd): engine hits/rehit/travel rules, hyde dash 2/3/4-hit rush with soft push between hits, launch on the final hit only; Kade/Hyde/Tessa dp_S x3, Vexa x2, Braakk/Sable charge x2 — throws and projectiles stay single-hit by law, and every multi total sits at old-damage +0..+3.

Corpse rescue: the branch sat pushed-but-abandoned for 3.5h with sim and harness complete; this session rebased it clean, re-ran every gate (ironringcheck 69 ok, watchcheck iron-ring 113/113, lint+build green) and merged under rule 5.

ironringcheck grew 43→69: 26 multi-hit gates — exact hit counts through real pad streams, spacing caps, launch-final, budget table, determinism with live dashes — plus a mutant (cap forced to 1) that reddens exactly the reconnect gates and leaves every single-hit gate green.
jalfern.com answers 308 on exact paths — prod marker polls must follow redirects (curl -L), or they silently poll the redirect body forever. Nightly #47 @ 1ab2ffd is the all-fixes verdict carrier.
